summary: dsh-llm-agy is a dsh plugin that integrates Antigravity CLI, enabling sub-agent delegation, deep web search, and image-to-text support for text models with a connectivity diagnostics settings panel.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The repository is best classified as an external-services integration plugin: it extends DeepSeek Harness by integrating Antigravity CLI/Gemini into the host for LLM subagent delegation, deep web search, and image-to-text support, with diagnostics and setup UI exposed in plugin settings. Evidence from README and package metadata consistently describes a dsh bundle patch/plugin-based extension and external provider/tool wiring, so the primary user-facing purpose is connecting dsh workflows to external AI tooling.
